name: OMPxContract treasury-inventory mispricing
summary: getBuyBackPrice divides the contract's ETH reserve by token.totalSupply() even though the contract itself held ~79% of that supply as unsold inventory, so purchase() sold that inventory for a fraction of the reserve share it entitles the buyer to and buyBack() immediately redeemed it at the full per-supply price, letting a flash-loaned purchase/buyBack loop drain the reserve.
notes: The verified non-proxy runtime was created in this transaction and remained byte-identical through the exploit.
The exact amount is the victim contract's net ETH outflow across seven purchase/buyBack rounds in the exploit trace. It excludes the attacker's flash-loan principal and transaction gas.
